items.title: Marshall Lawrence Interview, 1960-06-28
items.q: That couldn't have been Banzi, huh?

ctx.x: Downstairs, they used to sell seafood. And they used to buy fish and oysters. And upstairs, they was dancing places. We took that picture in that place. On Rampart Street. Right. Right by the station.
That couldn't have been Banzi, huh? No. Not Banzi for you.
He used to book different bands. Joe Robichaux and our band and some other bands.
